Yes. A damaged item is handled differently from a standard return.

For a normal return, items must be unworn, unaltered, and unwashed with original tags attached, and the return window is within 21 days of shipment. Mail-in refunds also have a $10 return handling fee, while exchanges and store credit are free.

For a damaged or faulty item, it needs to be reported much sooner. Shipment errors or damaged products must be reported within 48 hours of package arrival or the item will not be refunded. If the product is faulty, you should reach out within 7 days of the delivery date.
